Introduction | 01

Introduction | With | the | development | of | intelligent | technology, | the | functions | of | cameras | are | becoming | more | and | more | abundant | . | In | addition | to | regional | monitoring, | it | can | also | detect | faces | and | track | a | person | in | real | time | in | a | certain | area, | which | is | face | tracking | . | These | highly | intelligent | cameras | will | track | the | position | of | the | face | when | detecting | a | face, | thereby | realizing | the | function | of | face | tracking | . | We | can | also | use | the | face | detection | function | of | the | AI | ௙௙YLVLRQ | module | to | make | a | face | tracking | robot | and | experience | the | application | value | of | face | recognition | .
New Knowledge | 02

Face tracking | Face | tracking | is | to | continue | to | capture | the | location | and | size | of | the | face | in | subsequent | frames | after | the | face | is | detected, | including | face | recognition | and | face | tracking | technology | . | The | AI | ௙௙YLVLRQ | module | has | the | function | of | face | detection | . | When | the | AI | ௙௙YLVLRQ | module | detects | a | face | using | a | camera, | it | returns | the | X | and | Y | coordinate | values | ௙௙RI | the | face | to | the | controller | and | uses | the | X | and | Y | coordinates | to | determine | the | face | position | .

Face tracking | In | the | face | recognition | mode | of | the | AI | ௙௙YLVLRQ | module, | the | X | coordinate | (i | . | e | . | , | horizontal | coordinate) | ranges | from | 0 | to | 240 | , | and | the | Y | coordinate | (i | . | e | . | , | vertical | coordinate) | ranges | from | 0 | to | 180 | . | The | X | and | Y | coordinates | in | the | upper | left | corner | of | the | camera | screen | are | the | origin, | and | the | coordinates | are | ( | 0 | , | 0 | ) | . | When | the | camera | captures | a | face, | the | coordinates | of | the | face | in | the | screen | are | (X, | Y), | that | is, | the | combination | of | the | horizontal | coordinate | and | the | vertical | coordinate | is | the | position | of | the | face | captured | by | the | camera | . | Origin (0,0) | X | - | axis (Horizontal  | coordinate) | Y | - | axis (Vertical  | coordinate)

Face detection | When | entering | the | face | detection | mode, | the | AI | ௙௙YLVLRQ | module | starts | to | detect | faces | and | identify | coordinates | . | When | a | face | is | recognized, | a | green | box | will | appear | on | the | screen | to | capture | the | face | . | The | center | point | of | the | box | is | the | X | and | Y | coordinates | of | the | face | . | Coordinates of  | the face (X, Y)
